summary: The 2020 amendment of the 2014 examination regulations rewrites section 7 (2): 84 ECTS compulsory basic phase, 57 ECTS compulsory main phase, 12 ECTS environmental engineering electives, 9 ECTS engineering electives, a 16-ECTS engineering internship, three 6-ECTS key-competency modules (interdisciplinary, law, economics) and the 14-ECTS thesis (210 ECTS). An approved study plan is required for both elective blocks (section 7 (5)). Unamended 2014 section 7 (4) and the study plan still print 87, 15 and 12 (2x6) credits and an 11-credit thesis; the 2020 section 7 (2) figures are the binding composition.

categories.name: Environmental engineering electives
categories.note: 12 ECTS from this area under the 2020 amendment of section 7 (2). Verkehrstechnik I is an engineering elective in study plan B3 and does not count here. An approved study plan is required (section 7 (5)).

categories.name: Engineering electives
categories.note: 9 ECTS under the 2020 amendment of section 7 (2), from this area or Verkehrstechnik I. The 2014 study-plan line of 2x6 credits belongs to the replaced 12-credit total. An approved study plan is required (section 7 (5)).

categories.name: Key competencies (interdisciplinary)
categories.note: 6 ECTS additive interdisciplinary key competencies, required by the 2020 amendment of section 7 (2). The amendment states no separate course list for this block.

categories.name: Key competencies (law)
categories.note: 6 ECTS. Einführung in das Umweltrecht (3 ECTS) is compulsory and one further 3-ECTS course is chosen from the law catalogue. This semester only the umbrella module is offered.

categories.name: Key competencies (economics)
categories.note: 6 ECTS in any combination from the economics catalogue. Grundlagen wissenschaftlichen Schreibens may be used in law or in economics, only once. This semester only the umbrella module is offered.
